questions.question: What does chapter 10 record between the major judges?
options: A great and decisive battle against the Philistines
Minor judges (Tola and Jair) and renewed oppression
The anointing and crowning of Israel's first king
A widespread famine that struck the whole land
questions.answer: Minor judges (Tola and Jair) and renewed oppression

questions.question: What did Israel do that angered the LORD again?
options: Built golden idols in the tabernacle
Served the gods of the surrounding nations
Refused to march out at all against the enemy
Made a treaty with the kings of Moab
questions.answer: Served the gods of the surrounding nations

questions.question: Israel cried out to the LORD, confessing that they had sinned.
When Israel put away their foreign _____, the LORD could bear their misery no longer.
The minor judges _____ and Jair judged Israel in this chapter.
